description: Start one temporary in-memory upload for a large NodeSet2 XML document. Call this once for the old baseline and once for the new candidate when the complete XML documents are too large for audit_nodeset_compatibility. It returns upload_id and max_total_chars. Append that document's chunks in original order with append_nodeset_chunk. Uploads expire after 15 minutes and the service allows at most four active uploads; this tool stores only temporary process memory and does not modify an external system.
name: begin_nodeset_upload
